newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices remain steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices remain steady.

text.p: Cotton prices held steady for the second day in a row on Wednesday in dull trade, dealers said.
They said reports of a proposed rise in cotton prices by 500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) by a state-run procurement agency kept traders to hold on to their stocks.
"The market is watching the move," said a dealer.
In spot, Bengal-deshi remained unchanged at 1,010/1,030 rupees per maund (37.32 kg). F-414 was steady at 2,110 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) was offered at 14,500/14,700 rupees per candy.
